interpretation: Buffered put is 47% of pure-Blake ops/s — Blake-scale cost may matter.
Memory put 979562 ops/s vs Buffered 135366 — large gap ⇒ time spent in segment OS write path (stall/wait), not only index CPU.
Raw write_all 1023834 ops/s vs Buffered put 135366 — store adds 7.6× wall vs raw same-size writes.
Low process %CPU + low disk gauges with large Memory→Buffered gap = classic blocking I/O wait (thread not runnable), not pure compute.
